list.title: Hobits
list.subtitle: Configurable agents that reason over your repositories.

view.config_desc: Saved as overrides. The charter is passed as the agent's persona.

charter.label: Charter (persona)
charter.desc: Who the hobit is — passed as the agent's system prompt.

instructions.label: Instructions (task)
instructions.desc: What the hobit should do and produce. Change this to change its behavior. The context snapshot and the required JSON output format are added automatically.

run.title: Mental model (Repo-Onboarding hobit)
run.desc: Run the Repo-Onboarding hobit to write an L3 mental model into this repo's context. It explores the clone with Claude — this can take a minute.
